Meet-AI

Stop taking attendance. Start reading reports.

Meet-AI sits quietly in Chrome during your Google Meet or Zoom call. When it ends, you get a complete attendance report automatically.

  • Join, leave and rejoin times for every participant
  • Late joiners and brief drop-ins flagged
  • Hand raises and a speaker-wise caption transcript
  • Absent alerts by email for scheduled meetings

From meeting to report in four steps

Set it up once. Every meeting after that takes zero extra effort.

Step 1

Install the extension

Add Meet-AI to Chrome (also works in Edge and Brave).

Step 2

Connect your account

Click Connect in the extension and approve it on your dashboard. No password is typed into the extension.

Step 3

Join the meeting

Tracking starts on its own once you are in the call. A small “MeetTrack live” badge confirms it.

Step 4

Get the report

When the call ends, the report downloads and is saved to your dashboard.

E-Docs

28 PDF tools, plus translation in 11 languages.

Merge, compress, convert and sign PDFs for free. Then translate them from English into Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and more, and download the result as Word or PDF.

  • Translation is the headline. Upload a PDF, Word or TXT file and get it back in another Indian language.
  • Organise, convert, edit, sign and protect PDFs in one place
  • Files are processed in your browser, no upload needed
  • Log in to save your files and see your history on any device

Problems we solve

Three everyday headaches for teams and institutions.

Unreliable attendance

Manual tracking is slow and error-prone. Meet-AI does it for you, with timestamps.

Document chaos

Merging, compressing or converting a PDF usually means a different app each time. E-Docs puts it all in one.

Websites left unattended

Launching a site is only the start. Our maintenance plans keep it secure, updated and online.

Built on trust

Three principles behind everything we ship.

Your data stays yours

E-Docs processes files inside your browser. Files are saved only if you sign in and choose to.

No data selling

Meet-AI data stays in your own workspace and is never sold to third parties.

Direct support

Talk straight to the founders when you need help.
